reason: Deliberate CM_FRIEND_STATUS watcher canary; exactly one warning proves the game packet run-path logger is observed.
One exact Java-compatible CM_EMOTION error: the LIVE watcher canary sends an unknown emotion, while M6 sends valid START_GLIDE which Java also logs as unknown.
Deliberately corrupted encrypted login frame; exactly one warning proves the login-server socket logger is observed.
Deliberate unknown chat opcode; exactly one warning proves the chat-server client logger is observed.
M2 deliberately sends one out-of-region movement update to pin Java's despawn-and-bind-position quirk.
Java-compatible QuestSpawnAnalyzer startup report for the 80 missing-spawn groups classified and pinned by P7-01/P7-02.

Java-shared: IronWallWarfrontInstance has no portToStartPosition (its portToPosition(Player, WorldMapInstance) is never called), so AutoPvpInstance.onPressEnter reaches GeneralInstanceHandler.portToStartPosition, which throws, and the CM_AUTO_GROUP enter is logged as an error. INSTANCES-PVP asserts this one press; a correction awaits the maintainer.

Java-shared: AutoPvpInstance.onEnterInstance and AutoHarmonyInstance.onEnterInstance make each side's auto group with PlayerGroupService.createGroup(player, player, ...), which adds the leader twice, so GeneralTeam.onEvent warns that the second PlayerGroupEnteredEvent was skipped: once per group, up to six in a row stage (three dredgion matches of two sides).

Java-shared: AutoPvpInstance.onEnterInstance makes a side of more than six (Kamar Battlefield, Iron Wall Warfront) with PlayerAllianceService.createAlliance(player, player, ...), which adds the leader twice, so GeneralTeam.onEvent warns that the second PlayerAllianceEnteredEvent was skipped: once per alliance, up to four in a row stage (two Kamar matches of two sides).

Java-shared: Kamar Battlefield (301120000) has no instance_exit row, so BasicPvpInstance.leaveInstance's TeleportService.moveToInstanceExit warns and sends the player to bind. The structured Race/WorldId template merges the former Elyos/Asmodian fingerprints (4f7072fd, 66c76e9e): the same total of 48 in a row stage (two matches of twelve per race). INSTANCES-PVP separately enforces the original cap of 24 for each race and this map only.

Java-shared: DredgionInstance.startInstanceTask schedules openFirstDoors 120 s after the first entry without keeping the task, so onInstanceDestroy's stopInstanceTask cannot cancel it; a match everyone leaves in its first two minutes is destroyed with its doors, and the task's WorldMapInstance.setDoorState then warns, with an exception, that each door does not exist (doors 17 and 18 of Baranath Dredgion, 4 and 173 of Chantra and Terath Dredgion): up to 24 in a run (four matches of each dredgion).
